reason: I might open the free version once on a Sunday out of curiosity, but I'm not paying for the 12-dish pack. When a dish goes wrong I call my mum, and tom yum or massaman I can learn from a free YouTube video.
objection: Why pay an app for recipes my family already knows, when there are free videos for every one of these dishes? And pre-ordering something that doesn't exist yet feels odd.
would_change_my_mind: If the free dishes actually saved my Sunday meal prep a few weeks in a row and the cook-ahead plan really came out around 40 baht a meal, I'd pay 99 once for more.
